title: Concrete Pour Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Concrete Pour Job Safety Analysis template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.
standard: OSHA 29 Cfr 1926 Subpart Q - Concrete & Masonry
html:
Project Information

JSA ID: CONC-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

PROJECT: ______________ LOCATION: ______________ VOLUME: ______________ yards

POUR TYPE: ☐ Slab ☐ Wall ☐ Column ☐ Foundation FINISHER: ______________ CREW SIZE: ______________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Formwork Inspection-Unstable forms
-Missing ties
-Worn shoring		-Form failure
-Concrete blowout
-Collapse		16 (HIGH)-Inspect forms before pour
-Verify bracing and ties
-Check alignment and plumb
-Ensure clean forms
2. Pump Setup & Hose Handling-Outrigger failure
-High pressure
-Pinch points		-Tip over
-Hose whip
-Injection injury		20 (VERY HIGH)-Set pump on stable ground
-Use outrigger pads
-Inspect hoses for damage
-Never bend hose past radius
3. Concrete Placement-Skin contact with cement
-Heavy hoses
-Slippery surfaces		-Chemical burns
-Strains/ sprains
-Slips/falls		12 (HIGH)-Wear alkali-resistant gloves
-Use rubber boots
-Use team lifting for hoses
-Maintain good housekeeping
-Clean up spills immediately
4. Vibration & Finishing-Vibration exposure
-Electrical hazard		-HAVS (White Finger)
-Electrocution		9 (MODERATE)-Use low-vibration tools
-Take vibration breaks
-Use GFCI on all tools
-Keep cords out of water
5. Curing & Protection-Falls from height
-Rebor impalement
-Chemical curing agents		-Fall from height
-Puncture wounds
-Inhalation		15 (HIGH)-Cover rebar ends with caps
-Guard open edges
-Use fall protection if >6ft
-Post curing compound warning signs
-Use respirator if required

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Hard Hat ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ Rubber Boots ☐ Alkali-Resistant Gloves ☐ Rain Suit ☐ Gloves
